answer: Each agent must prove unique hardware by solving a device-bound challenge every epoch that demands 12 exclusive minutes of serial GPU time on a registered physical unit, attested via a remote oracle. An oasis of verified nodes runs the check; attackers on the system ledge pay full isolated compute per clone with zero parallelization possible, while the harbor of honest single agents incurs the cost only once. Massing 500 sybils requires 500 devices and 100 hours of sequential wall time, exceeding the 40 POA max payout per identity and rendering large-scale fabrication uneconomic.
